t: # Short Obligatory Prayer ## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon. Nallrunítua, Agayutma Piliaqlluavnga Nallunircesqelluten Ciktarvikesqelluten-llu. Watua, Nallurnitua, Pingalhuatengqertua Pingirpaun-ilu, Arrsaucimmun tukuutevnunllu. Illamek agayucetatuq Taugaam ellíirek, Ikayulaakvut Aarnarqelramek, Camek elpet Piurilavet.
